title: festuca lutea
intro: Festuca lutea, commonly known as Golden Bentgrass, is a type of grass native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and promote digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Festuca lutea include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
